summary: Novo Nordisk filed a Form 6-K disclosing that the FDA's review of its Biologics License Application for denecimig, an investigational haemophilia A prophylactic, remains ongoing past the anticipated third-quarter 2026 decision date, with no new timeline communicated. The extension stems from facility remediation activities at the manufacturing site, not clinical efficacy or safety deficiencies; no adverse findings were identified in the FRONTIER programme data. Novo reaffirmed its 2026 financial outlook and targets a US launch in the first half of 2027, with European approval pending after a positive CHMP opinion on 17 September.
